questions.question:
Identify the correct form of the sentence with inversion required for emphasis:

It was not until she received the letter that she realised the truth.

Which of the following is the correct inverted structure?
options: Only when she received the letter did she realise the truth.
Not until she received the letter she realised the truth.
She realised the truth not until she received the letter.
Until she received the letter she did not realise the truth.
questions.answer: Only when she received the letter did she realise the truth.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail about the discovery?
options: It was the old photograph that revealed the family secret.
The old photograph it was that revealed the family secret.
The family secret was revealed by the old photograph.
Revealing the family secret was the old photograph.
questions.answer: It was the old photograph that revealed the family secret.

questions.question:
Select the correct form of the sentence using the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical condition:

If only we _______ the opportunity to explore the Amazon rainforest last year!
options: had been given
were given
should be given
could have been given

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly employs ellipsis to maintain grammatical parallelism and coherence?
options: The committee members agreed on the budget cuts, but not on the timeline for implementation.
The committee members agreed on the budget cuts, but not the timeline for implementation.
The committee members agreed on the budget cuts, but not about the timeline for implementation.
The committee members agreed on the budget cuts, but not to the timeline for implementation.
questions.answer: The committee members agreed on the budget cuts, but not on the timeline for implementation.

questions.question: Identify the correct formal register sentence that appropriately uses complex sentence structure to convey a nuanced grammatical choice regarding the proposal:
options: The proposal requires further consideration because there are unresolved issues that need to be addressed.
The proposal requires further consideration because there are unresolved issues that need to be addressed.
The proposal requires further consideration because there are unresolved issues that need to be addressed.
The proposal requires further consideration because there are unresolved issues that need to be addressed.
questions.answer: The proposal requires further consideration because there are unresolved issues that need to be addressed.
